explanation: The theorem says that a bitmask-encoded matrix multiplication on lists of naturals (`mulN`, built from `mvN`, a testBit/xor fold over 11 bits) agrees with `Matrix` multiplication after decoding through the library's own `toMat`. All three of `toMat`, `mvN` and `mulN` are custom definitions in this library (ClsBits.lean). Their content is the library-specific encoding and the correctness proof of that encoding. Mathlib has no declaration about this encoding, only general `Matrix.mul` lemmas. I did not search Mathlib further, since the statement depends entirely on these local definitions.
